scientific_integrity: Exact finite probability law and all fixed-real-order moment limits are supported by a full analytic proof. Numerical checks independently corroborate the combinatorial law and asymptotic constants but are not infinite proofs. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Uniform four-vertex samples from exact regular polygons only; crossings weighted as pairs, not distinct spatial intersection points; fixed moment order q in n-to-infinity limits. No uniform near-critical scaling or affine perturbation assertion.
title: Critical transversality moments for crossings of regular-polygon diagonals
